Run an End-to-End Nested Cross-Validation Survival Pipeline (E1)

Source: R/nested_survival_run.R
nested_survival_run.Rd

Executes the complete multi-stage nested survival analysis workflow in a single call:

  1. Pre-flight data validation via [validate_start_stop()] (stopping or warning on structural anomalies or absence of censoring).

  2. Grouped nested resampling fold construction via [rsample::nested_cv()] and [rsample::group_vfold_cv()].

  3. Inner hyperparameter tuning across outer folds via [tune_alpha_by_split()] with per-task fingerprinted checkpoints.

  4. Candidate model selection via [select_candidate_models()].

  5. Outer-fold model scoring via [score_outer()] with fingerprinted checkpoints.

  6. Predictor importance and selection stability summarization across outer folds via [summarize_outer_importance()].

  7. Censoring weight sensitivity comparison via [compare_censoring_weights()] (automatically skipping the duplicate fit when the training data has no censored subjects).

Usage

nested_survival_run(
  data,
  recipe = NULL,
  id = "id",
  start = "tstart",
  stop = "tstop",
  status = "status",
  domain = "default",
  run_dir = NULL,
  shard = NULL,
  collect = FALSE,
  feature_names = NULL,
  formulas = NULL,
  outer_v = 5L,
  inner_v = 5L,
  inner_bootstraps = NULL,
  nested_folds = NULL,
  alphas = NULL,
  num_alpha_values = 6L,
  num_fixed = min(6L, as.integer(num_alpha_values)),
  ntile = 0.25,
  top_n = NULL,
  select_by = c("row", "alpha"),
  internal_folds = 5L,
  censoring_weights = c("ipcw", "none"),
  coefficients = c("all", "nonzero"),
  compare_censoring = TRUE,
  no_censoring_action = c("warn", "stop", "ignore"),
  error_on_invalid = TRUE,
  checkpoint_mismatch = c("recompute", "overwrite", "error"),
  chunk_size = NULL,
  seed = 42L,
  on_complete = getOption("templecbe.on_complete", NULL),
  progress = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing counting-process `(start, stop]` or right-censored survival intervals.

recipe

Optional [recipes::recipe()] object specifying preprocessing. When `NULL`, a default recipe is built on `data` assigning `id`, `start`, `stop`, and `status` the `"id variable"` role.

id, start, stop, status

Column names (as strings or bare symbols) for subject identifier, interval start time, interval stop time, and event status indicator (`0` = censored, `1` = event). Defaults to `"id"`, `"tstart"`, `"tstop"`, and `"status"`.

domain

Character label identifying the clinical or modeling domain (default `"default"`).

run_dir

Optional directory path where fingerprinted checkpoints, stage artifacts (`nested_survival_run.rds`), and `render_manifest.json` are stored.

shard

Optional integer vector `c(i, n)` specifying that this machine should evaluate shard `i` of `n` into `run_dir`.

collect

Logical (default `FALSE`). When `TRUE` and `run_dir` contains completed sharded checkpoints, merges them with [collect_checkpoints()] before computing candidate selection, outer importance, and summaries.

feature_names

Optional character vector of candidate predictor column names. Defaults to all predictor variables in `recipe` (or all columns of `data` other than `id`, `start`, `stop`, and `status`).

formulas

Optional character vector or list of candidate right-hand-side formulas. Defaults to a single full formula combining `feature_names`.

outer_v

Number of outer cross-validation folds (default `5L`).

inner_v

Number of inner cross-validation folds (default `5L`).

inner_bootstraps

Optional integer number of grouped inner bootstrap resamples (when non-`NULL`, uses [rsample::group_bootstraps()] instead of [rsample::group_vfold_cv()] for the inner resamples).

nested_folds

Optional pre-constructed [rsample::nested_cv()] object. Overrides `outer_v`, `inner_v`, and `inner_bootstraps` when supplied.

alphas

Optional numeric vector of elastic-net mixing values in \([0, 1]\) for inner tuning.

num_alpha_values

Number of alpha values to generate when `alphas` is `NULL` (default `6L`).

num_fixed

Number of evenly spaced fixed alpha values when `alphas` is `NULL` (default `min(6L, num_alpha_values)`).

ntile

Quantile cutoff in `(0, 1]` passed to [select_candidate_models()] (default `0.25`).

top_n

Optional integer number of top alphas to select in [select_candidate_models()] (overrides `ntile` when non-`NULL`).

select_by

Selection granularity for [select_candidate_models()]: `"row"` (default) or `"alpha"`.

internal_folds

Number of internal folds passed to [glmnet_IBS()] (default `5L`).

censoring_weights

Primary censoring weight scheme for tuning and outer scoring: `"ipcw"` (default) or `"none"`.

coefficients

Which coefficients to store in [score_outer()]: `"all"` (default) or `"nonzero"`.

compare_censoring

Logical (default `TRUE`). Run [compare_censoring_weights()] on the candidate grid across outer folds.

no_censoring_action

Action when [validate_start_stop()] detects zero censored subjects (`n_censored == 0`): `"warn"` (default), `"stop"`, or `"ignore"`.

error_on_invalid

Logical (default `TRUE`). Stop immediately if [validate_start_stop()] detects structural interval errors.

checkpoint_mismatch

Action when an existing checkpoint in `run_dir` has a mismatched fingerprint: `"recompute"` (default), `"overwrite"`, or `"error"`.

chunk_size

Optional integer number of tasks per worker chunk passed to [tune_alpha_by_split()] and [score_outer()] (default `NULL`).

seed

Integer RNG seed for reproducible fold construction, tuning, and outer scoring (default `42L`).

on_complete

Optional callback `function(result)` invoked when the run completes or errors (defaults to `getOption("templecbe.on_complete", NULL)`).

progress

Logical (default `FALSE`). Display progress bars.

...

Additional arguments passed to [glmnet_IBS()] (e.g. `cox.ties`, `rule`, `metric`, `tune_engine`, `eval_time`).

Value

An S3 object of class `cbe_nested_survival_run` containing:

`domain`

Domain identifier string.

`validation`

Result of [validate_start_stop()].

`nested_folds`

The [rsample::nested_cv()] object.

`tune_results`

Tibble of inner tuning results across outer folds.

`candidates`

Tibble of candidate models from [select_candidate_models()].

`outer_scores`

Tibble of outer-fold model evaluations from [score_outer()].

`outer_coefficients`

Long tibble of outer-fold coefficients from [tidy_outer_coefficients()].

`importance`

Predictor importance summary tibble from [summarize_outer_importance()].

`censoring_comparison`

Tibble from [compare_censoring_weights()] (when `compare_censoring = TRUE`).

`run_dir`

Normalized path to `run_dir` (or `NULL`).

`fingerprint`

SHA-256 fingerprint of the run configuration and data.

`seed`

RNG seed used.

`seed_scheme`

Seed generation scheme version (`"v0.5.6"`).

`shard`

Shard specification (`NULL` or `c(i, n)`).

`status`

`"completed"` or `"shard_completed"`.

Details

When `run_dir` is provided, every stage writes fingerprinted checkpoints and a run manifest (`render_manifest.json`) into `run_dir` and resumes from disk on rerun without recomputing completed tasks. When `shard = c(i, n)` is supplied, only shard `i` of `n` is evaluated; once all shards finish, rerun with `shard = NULL` (or `collect = TRUE`) to merge checkpoints and finalize the run object.

See also

[validate_start_stop()], [tune_alpha_by_split()], [select_candidate_models()], [score_outer()], [summarize_outer_importance()], [compare_censoring_weights()], [collect_checkpoints()], [repro_appendix()]
